questions.question: What is the map() operator?
questions.answer: The map() operator transforms each value emitted by an Observable by applying a function to it. It returns the transformed value without changing the original source value.
questions.answerMarathi: map() operator Observable मधून emit होणाऱ्या प्रत्येक value वर function लागू करून नवीन value तयार करतो. तो original source value बदलत नाही; transformed value पुढे emit करतो.

questions.question: What is an Observable in RxJS?
questions.answer: An Observable is a stream of values that can arrive over time. It can emit values, report an error, or complete. You subscribe to an Observable to receive its notifications.
questions.answerMarathi: Observable म्हणजे वेळेनुसार values emit करणारा stream. तो values देऊ शकतो, error देऊ शकतो किंवा complete होऊ शकतो. त्याचे notifications मिळवण्यासाठी subscribe() वापरतात.

questions.question: What is the switchMap() operator?
questions.answer: switchMap() maps each source value to an inner Observable and switches to the latest one. It unsubscribes from the previous inner Observable, making it useful for search requests where only the latest result matters.
questions.answerMarathi: switchMap() प्रत्येक source value साठी inner Observable तयार करतो आणि नवीन value आल्यावर मागील inner Observable मधून unsubscribe करून नवीन stream वापरतो. Search autocomplete सारख्या ठिकाणी तो उपयुक्त आहे.

questions.question: What is the difference between mergeMap() and switchMap()?
questions.answer: mergeMap() subscribes to multiple inner Observables and allows them to run concurrently. switchMap() keeps only the latest inner Observable and unsubscribes from the previous one. Choose based on whether every request must finish or only the latest result matters.
questions.answerMarathi: mergeMap() अनेक inner Observables एकाच वेळी चालू ठेवू शकतो. switchMap() नवीन inner Observable आल्यावर आधीच्या inner Observable मधून unsubscribe करतो. प्रत्येक request पूर्ण होणे आवश्यक आहे की फक्त नवीनतम result हवा आहे, यानुसार operator निवडा.

questions.question: What does catchError() do in RxJS?
questions.answer: catchError() intercepts an error from an Observable and lets you return another Observable, such as a fallback value or a replacement request. Place it where you want the error to be handled.
questions.answerMarathi: catchError() Observable मधील error पकडतो आणि त्याऐवजी fallback value देणारा किंवा दुसरी request करणारा Observable return करू देतो. Error कुठे handle करायचा आहे त्यानुसार तो pipe() मध्ये योग्य ठिकाणी वापरा.
